title: Hornet's three fates in Hollow Knight: Silksong
subject: hornet
description:
Which ending did you get first? 👇

What happens to Hornet after Grand Mother Silk in the Weaver Queen, Twisted Child and Sister of the Void endings. Spoilers for Hollow Knight: Silksong.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Team Cherry. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Hornet can finish Silksong with six extra arms.
Captured and carried to Pharloom, a kingdom ruled by silk and song, she climbs to its Citadel.
Grand Mother Silk waits at the end of Act 2. Bind her, and Hornet grows them as the new Weaver Queen.
Fight her while cursed, and Hornet, Grand Mother Silk and the Cradle twist into roots.
Gather three Old Hearts in Act 3 and the Void opens instead.
The Knight, her sibling from Hallownest, carries Hornet and Lace to the surface.
Grand Mother Silk's threads vanish. The ending is called Sister of the Void.
